description: The last seven days of the channel's schedule in one call, for an agent, paid per call, with no account. Select the title or category across collected days and receive calendar events with absolute times. You do not need to merge daily records and write a calendar exporter. Only collected dates are returned. This is metadata, not a video archive, a broadcast license or a guarantee that a channel plays.

agenda.description: Include agenda_ics with the selected calendar events.

programa.description: Title or category substring. Input and matches are not truncated.

slug.description: Stored slug of the channel, from the collection.
